ground_truth.title: The open source alternative to Trello
ground_truth.main_content:
The open source
alternative to Trello

A powerful, flexible kanban app that helps you organise work, track progress, and deliver results—all in one place.

No credit card required

Trusted by fast-moving teams
around the world

Features

Kanban reimagined

Simple, visual task management that just works. Drag and drop cards, collaborate with your team, and get more done.

Board visibility

Control who can view and edit your boards.

Workspace members

Collaborate seamlessly with your team.

Trello imports

Import your Trello boards and hit the ground running.

Labels & Filters

Organize and find cards quickly with powerful filtering tools.

Discuss and collaborate on cards.

Activity logs

Track all card changes with detailed activity history.

Templates

Save time with reusable board templates.

New

Integrations

Connect your favorite tools to streamline your workflow.

Coming soon

We're just getting started. View our roadmap.

Testimonials

Loved by teams worldwide

See what our users are saying about Kan

Bobby Compüters @bobbycomputers

Holy crap I love this app. It's brutally minimal but somehow has everything I need.

JR Raphael @JRRaphael

The interesting thing about signing into Kan for the first time is that it feels new and electrifying—and yet simultaneously quite familiar, especially if you’ve spent any time in Trello over the years.

As someone who connected more with Trello’s original vision and mostly just tolerated the more recent pivots and additions, it’s a bit of a revelation to use.

At its core, Kan gives you a super-minimalist and frills-free Trello-style Kanban board. And the extent to which it has been able to build upon the original Trello vision is staggering.

singiamtel @singiamtel

The project seems nice, but how good is that domain name

Jan Stgmnn @JanStgmnn

Just wanted to say, that I really love the project. It's so easy to use and has a really nice UI!

Fox @dscfox

I've been looking at alternatives for months, but everything came up short.

Some were direct clones, but lacked features I was dependent on. Others were rich in features, but strayed too far away from the simplicity of Trello.

This seems like the best alternative to Trello for me.

Hanno Braun @hannobraun

I've been very impressed with the app so far! It's great to have such a nice open source alternative to Trello.

headlessdev_ @headlessdev_

This is the best thing I've seen here in a long time

EHB @ehb3839

It's exactly what I've been looking for recently. The simplicity of the overall app is a pleasure to use.

Tasneema Waquar @tasneema_waquar

The design of this project management tool is impressive. The interface is intuitive, free of unnecessary clutter, and comes with a solid selection of templates.

BRAVO68WEB @bravo68web

I have fallen in love with the project.
